narration_timeline.text: Why do city pigeons keep checking the ground, even beside busy streets?
narration_timeline.scene: Real city pigeons pecking and looking at the ground; no flight implied.

narration_timeline.text: Their daily search for seeds and scraps takes them from sidewalks to station ledges.
narration_timeline.scene: A city pigeon perched on a station ledge, not falsely depicted as feeding.

narration_timeline.text: One pigeon moves along a city walkway; in another scene, a pigeon pauses on the pavement.
narration_timeline.scene: Two independent original city-pigeon scenes; verify visible bird movement in the new Ljubljana Breg clip, then a separate pigeon on pavement. Do not imply continuous encounter.

narration_timeline.text: They pause, look around, and move again, checking each new patch for something edible.
narration_timeline.scene: Real rock pigeon moving on grass, with foraging explanation in narration.

narration_timeline.text: When food is on the ground, several pigeons can feed side by side.
narration_timeline.scene: Real pigeons feeding in an urban park.

narration_timeline.text: From parks to busy crossings, a pigeon's next meal may be only a few steps away.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate genuine pigeon group feeding scenes on a pier and in an urban setting; no invented continuity.
